key_findings: Moxibustion plus ultrashort wave improved VAS, WOMAC and Lysholm scores more than moxibustion alone in elderly KOA patients.
Combination lowered serum IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, MDA and miR-155 and raised SOD and NLRP3.
